description: The Dropbox plugin brings your files directly into ChatGPT, so you can find and work with Dropbox content in conversation. Save ChatGPT-generated content to Dropbox or create sharing links without switching tools. Your existing Dropbox permissions always apply, and ChatGPT only accesses files available to you.
